==Rewards==
Once a contract is complete, players will receive [[carpenter points]] dependent on their job tier and [[Construction]] experience. In terms of experience efficient reward purchase order, the [[plank sack]] is the highest priority for continued Mahogany Homes training with, followed by Amy's saw, then Carpenter's Outfit pieces in any order. When using a [[plank sack]] alongside efficient teleports and the [[NPC Contact]] spell, players can expect to complete around 50-60 contracts per hour. The cost-per-point can be identified by averaging the cost per contract mentioned above. For instance, using mahogany planks would cost an estimated {{Nocoins|12.71*{{GEP|Mahogany plank}}*400+0.5*{{GEP|Steel bar}}*400|c}} in materials to obtain the full Carpenter's outfit. For the complete log you need to complete 975 Expert contracts at an estimated {{Nocoins|12.71*{{GEP|Mahogany plank}}*975+0.5*{{GEP|Steel bar}}*975|c}} cost.
